node.statement: Entrywise corner estimate: writing X=(X_1,...,X_n)^t, amplified multiplication by U=I_n tensor u_P is entrywise, and lem-compcb-compressed-unit-action applied to each compatible level-one P,Q corner gives ||u_P dot X_j-X_j||<=C_co*e*||X_j|| for every j when e<=e_co.
